activity.name: Communication & Advance Care Planning
activity.description: Palliative & End of Life Care — Module 5. Covers person-centred communication (the 7-38-55 Rule), mental capacity and the Mental Capacity Act (2005), legal protections in advance care planning, and a branching scenario on conducting a Best Interests conversation with family members.

activity.name: The Best Interests Conversation
activity.description: A branching scenario in which the learner conducts a Best Interests conversation with a patient's family under the Mental Capacity Act (2005). Choices genuinely diverge: an early misstep changes the subsequent stages and can end the meeting early, rather than simply prompting an immediate retry.
